description: Machine-readable governance exception register for the Sprint 05 policy gate. Every active exception is validated against the exception-management baseline in docs/adr/0007-0011-hardening-delta-summary.md (max 90-day validity for critical governance exceptions). Expired or over-validity exceptions are hard promotion blockers (ADR-0010 Target 4, ADR-0011 Target 4).

exceptions.rationale: Sprint 00 tenant migration: temporary US-region (westus2) deployment on the new tenant MngEnvMCAP164444 for demonstration and proof-of-technology validation of North Star services that are not yet GA in switzerlandnorth. See ADR-0013.
compensatingControls: Synthetic sample data only (data/synthetic/*); no PHI, no real patient identifiers
No inbound connection from any Swiss KIS or hospital data source
Bicep @allowed in fabric and source-sql modules explicitly enumerates westus2 + switzerlandnorth so a slip to any other region fails at build time
Sprint report and runbook enforce the synthetic-only rule as a promotion gate
exceptions.mitigationPlan: Sunset when either (a) required target services reach GA in switzerlandnorth, or (b) expiry date reached — whichever comes first. Transfer of workload back to switzerlandnorth follows a separate migration decision.
